column1: # GH18 locus across Testudines: hmmsearch (dbCAN GH18 model, E<=1e-10, >=35 % model coverage) on RefSeq proteomes; miniprot of the Mimp_v3 locus models
# (identity >= 0.75, <=40 kb) against each genome; orthologous interval = span of the 3 upstream + 3 downstream flanking genes (MIMP3_g08465-67, g08480-82).
# Loci labelled by best-matching M. impressa model; pseudo = frameshift or in-frame stop in the best alignment. g08468 (TAF8, Pfam Bromo_TP+TAF8_C) and the 191-aa fragment g08471 are
# not counted; g08477 (243-aa GH18 fragment next to the CLP g08478) is listed separately. complete_GH18_genes_intact = loci other than the g08477 fragment without frameshift/stop.
